title: Flight controllers at the radio van
description: Two soldiers — flight controllers, Larry says, the same job he held — pose on the steel steps of the big riveted van where Larry did his radio operations. A power cable runs from the van to a field generator; CONEX containers, one with a red cross panel, stand in the background. The street in the background, he thinks, was the 18th Aviation unit's.
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0011-c18032554.json), confirming the survey's hypothesis that this is his operations van — the exterior of the interior seen in VN-0014/VN-0015. 'Flight controller' is Larry's own word for the job. The two men are not yet named; their name tapes are too distant to read at this scan's resolution. 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0011-c18415634.json, -c18415638.json): 'Location: Ton Son Nhut', and 'I think the street in the background is 18th Aviation unit.' His son, who typed it, confirms Larry said 18th. On 2026-09-13, asked cold by telephone, he described 18th Aviation as the big company whose offices his own small unit used, not as his unit (2026-09-13-phone-the-outfit.json). The unit's own name or number is an open question (ledger #2) and is not addressed in this record. Not checked.
